description: Copy personal memories into the project outbox as review drafts. The personal originals stay put. Use this when personal knowledge should enter a project's review flow; memory_submit then moves the drafts into the repo, and memory_promote advances drafts already there. (MCP server and the `open-memex propose` CLI; the opencode native plugin does not expose this tool.)

ids.description: Personal memory ids to copy into the project outbox.

localApprove.description: Single-developer shortcut: mark the copies approved immediately.

name: memory_propose
